topic: EgoVerse ecosystem: egocentric human data, human-to-robot transfer, evaluation, and industry collaboration

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: agent dynamic expansion (high): Expansion derived from the EgoVerse paper, official project pages, RSS 2026 program, and the repository seed survey.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egoverse-core
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover the core paper and follow-on work that explicitly names the living dataset ecosystem.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-danfei-egocentric-lineage
dynamic_suggestions.query: au:"Danfei Xu" AND all:(egocentric OR human-to-robot OR cross-embodiment)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover the direct research lineage without using the author as evidence by authority.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-named-lineage
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:(EgoMimic OR EgoBridge OR EMMA OR EgoScale) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover the capture, alignment, mobile-manipulation, and dexterous-scaling lineage around EgoVerse.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-emergent-human-robot-transfer
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"human to robot transfer" AND all:(VLA OR "vision-language-action" OR pretraining)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Test the hypothesis that diverse robot pretraining creates embodiment-agnostic transfer from human data.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-action-supervision
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"egocentric human data" AND all:(action OR trajectory OR retargeting OR policy)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find how human video is converted into robot-action supervision rather than used only for perception pretraining.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-dataset-composition-alignment
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"dataset composition" AND all:(robot OR manipulation) AND all:(alignment OR diversity OR retrieval)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover target relevance and diversity composition instead of treating hours as a sufficient quality measure.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-cross-lab-evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:("cross-lab" OR "multiple labs" OR reproducible) AND all:(robot learning OR manipulation) AND all:evaluation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find multi-site evaluation designs and limits relevant to EgoVerse's consortium-scale study.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-human-data-negative-transfer
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:("human video" OR "human data") AND all:robot AND all:("negative transfer" OR limitation OR failure OR mismatch)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Actively search for counterevidence and transfer failures.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-contact-limit
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND all:robot AND all:(contact OR tactile OR occlusion) AND all:(transfer OR imitation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover states that vision/pose-only human data may not observe reliably.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-data-governance-license
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:(robotics OR egocentric) AND all:dataset AND all:(license OR privacy OR provenance OR versioning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover governance and reproducibility limits of living, multi-provider datasets.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-rss26-adjacent
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:("robot-free egocentric" OR "human demonstrations" OR "cross-embodiment transfer") AND all:(manipulation OR imitation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover RSS 2026-adjacent routes without using venue acceptance as scientific evidence.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egoverse-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs EgoVerse egocentric human robot transfer
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover the core paper and explicit follow-ons if API metadata lags.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lineage-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (EgoMimic OR EgoBridge OR EMMA OR EgoScale) robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover named lineage papers and their identifiers.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-counterevidence-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs egocentric human data robot (failure OR limitation OR negative transfer)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find limiting or contradictory evidence that may be under-indexed.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-rss-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:roboticsconference.org 2026 EgoVerse human data imitation learning
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate official venue terminology and adjacent session names.

calibration_notes: rss-official calibration (high): Confirms EgoVerse as RSS 2026 Paper 92 in Datasets and Benchmarks.
rss-workshop-official calibration (high): Calibrates data-centric robotics terms: sources, quality versus scale, composition, evaluation, and data flywheels.
project-page calibration (medium): Confirms living dataset/ecosystem vocabulary and current partner list.
author-homepage calibration (medium): Confirms named lineage: EgoMimic, EgoBridge, EMMA, Emergence, and EgoVerse.
social-calibration calibration (low): Used only to discover new partner names and current ecosystem vocabulary.
